responsibility: Implements the low-level host exception/signal bridge for GNU Modula-2, installing sigaction handlers for signals such as SIGBUS, SIGSEGV, and SIGFPE when available and dispatching them to runtime-provided exception callbacks for invalid-location, divide, overflow, and related language exception classes. This file owns operating-system signal integration, not exception block management or language-facing exception queries.
same_name_distinction: Implements the host-side signal machinery behind the SysExceptions interface, including sigaction setup for SIGBUS, SIGSEGV, and SIGFPE and dispatch to registered callbacks, whereas gcc/m2/pge-boot/GSysExceptions.h only declares the callback type and registration entry point.
